formula_note: These are this protocol's definitions. They are not a recovered theorem from the unavailable L01 PDF, and broken PDF equation lines were not repaired.
teacher: beta_j proportional to (beta_geometric_ratio ** j) times a data-seed Rademacher sign, then Euclidean-normalized. Prefix energy is the recorded misspecification. The ratio is fixed before any fit so later columns are weak; it is not chosen from a risk curve.
sigma_rule: sigma = 1/sqrt(snr), from the unit teacher norm under identity covariance. The same numeric sigma is used for every spectrum. Empirical signal energy over n*sigma^2 is recorded because a decaying spectrum changes it.
centering: Latent standard-normal columns are centered and divided by their training ddof=0 standard deviation. Column j is then multiplied by the declared spectrum scale and is not divided by the empirical standard deviation of the scaled column. Evaluation rows reuse the training latent mean, latent scale and the same protocol spectrum scales. The response mean remains an unpenalized intercept. Random-feature ReLU columns are centered and scaled inside the readout solver; that second scaling is not applied to the linear design.
intercept: The unpenalized intercept is the training response mean. The ridge penalty applies only to the standardized slope coefficients. The coefficient norm does not include the intercept.
ridge_svd: Economy SVD of the standardized training design. Singular values at or below rcond_relative times the largest singular value are dropped. Retained coefficients are s / (s^2 + n*ridge_lambda). Lambda 0 uses that same path and is the minimum-norm least-squares fit on the retained subspace.
rank_target_rule: min(n_train - 1, n_features). Column centering confines training columns to the complement of the all-ones vector, so the proposal's min(n, p) target is impossible once means are removed. This rank target is the compatible reading of centering plus a full-rank residual check, and it is fixed before any fit.
interpolation_rule: For ridge_lambda 0 only: numerical rank equals the rank target and the training residual L2 norm divided by the training response L2 norm is <= relative_train_residual_tolerance. Positive lambda is not required to interpolate. A bracket is one cell with p < n whose residual exceeds the tolerance and one cell with p > n that interpolates.

random_features.nesting: One frozen weight matrix per draw; width N uses the first N columns. Inputs are all p_max covariates of that draw and spectrum.
random_features.family_note: This family is not predicted to reproduce the linear peak. Readout clean risk and the feature-Gram condition are recorded against N.

primary_contrasts.noise: isotropic spectrum, window-mean clean risk and coefficient norm at snr 1 minus the matched snr 5 quantities
primary_contrasts.spectrum: snr 1, lambda 0, window-mean clean risk of geometric minus isotropic, plus the relative condition-number gap at the column equal to n_train
primary_contrasts.ridge: isotropic spectrum, snr 1, window-mean clean risk and coefficient norm at lambda 0 minus each of 0.01, 0.1 and 1
primary_contrasts.random_features: isotropic spectrum, both snr values, lambda 0, Gram condition and clean risk against N

contrast_rule: On at least the minimum number of bracketed draws, a positive mean paired delta supports the named direction only when it meets the predeclared margin and exceeds the across-draw standard error. A nonpositive mean delta on every required component refutes that prediction. A positive delta below the margin or not above its standard error is inconclusive_within_noise. Fewer bracketed draws is not a refutation. Standard errors and min/max are descriptive and are not confidence intervals. No hypothesis test and no multiplicity adjustment are claimed.
estimand: Mean clean risk, the mean squared error against the noiseless teacher on the shared phase evaluation design. Noisy evaluation risk is recorded and is not substituted for clean risk. Draws are the independent repetition unit. Five discovery draws are a pilot size, not a power calculation.
